name: Minor Project
description: This project-based course provides students the opportunity to apply foundational robotics knowledge to address a specific real-world problem. Students will work individually or in small teams to design, implement, and evaluate a robotic system or subsystem using tools from mechanics, control, perception, planning, and learning.
